prompts.name: board-day
prompts.prompt: Generate a new game board background, using the supplied image ONLY as the visual style and camera reference. Match its old illustrated web board game look closely: hand-drawn dark brown ink outlines, flat muted grass greens, ochre and tan stone, crooked folk-art geometry, very limited cel shading, worn printed-paper grain, slightly rough imperfect lines. NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D, NOT cinematic, NOT glowing modern fantasy. Landscape 3:2 overhead three-quarter view of a small medieval village square with a round stone well/meeting circle in the center and EXACTLY TWELVE narrow cobblestone paths radiating out to twelve empty clearings around an oval perimeter. The clearings must stay EMPTY because separate house sprites will be placed on them by the game. Outer edge has a few illustrated pine trees, bushes, mushrooms, stones and wooden fences, like the reference. Calm daytime pale blue sky strip at top, flat olive grass below. Center open enough to place a small paper phase marker. No houses anywhere, no characters, no writing, no labels, no user interface, no logos. Full bleed aged board illustration. Keep the space clear around all twelve house positions.

prompts.name: houses-alive
prompts.prompt: Create a production sprite atlas of TWELVE SEPARATE medieval cottage sprites for the illustrated Werewolves game in the reference. STRICTLY match the reference's old flat inked board-game drawing: crooked timber frames, irregular stone foundation, bold dark-brown hand-drawn outlines, muted olive/tan/ochre/red/teal roofs, flat gouache fills, minimal cel shading and old printed-paper grain. Not realistic, not rendered 3D, no shiny lighting, no glow. Layout EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, twelve equal-sized cells, each cell containing ONE entire house centered with at least 12% transparent padding on ALL sides. Background TRUE TRANSPARENT. Every house has a different roof shape and little doorway; consistent overhead three-quarter camera angle and scale, no people. Occupied/alive daytime houses with normal open doors or small warm windows, a few hanging tools/woodpiles allowed, no signs with writing. Each isolated house includes a tiny flat ground shadow only; no connecting paths or shared terrain. No text, no labels, no borders, no grid lines. Canvas landscape 4:3 sprite sheet.

prompts.name: board-night
prompts.prompt: Edit ONLY the time of day of this exact illustrated village board to night. Preserve every stone, path, clearing, tree, well, camera framing, line and coordinate EXACTLY. Same old flat hand-inked board-game artwork, not realism, not 3D, no modern visual effects. Deep muted blue-violet night sky and desaturated olive grass, soft simple moonlight like painted gouache. All twelve empty house clearings must remain in exactly the same places. No new buildings, no people, no text. Make it dark enough to read as night but clear and playable.

prompts.name: houses-dead
prompts.prompt: Edit this exact TWELVE-HOUSE sprite atlas to its eliminated/unoccupied state. Preserve the FOUR COLUMN by THREE ROW grid, every house footprint, scale, position, roof silhouette, angle and transparent margins EXACTLY. Change ONLY doors and windows: close the shutters, board some doors with rough brown planks, extinguish the windows, remove fresh flowers. Keep the same flat hand-inked old European board-game style, bold dark-brown lines, restrained earthy palette, no realism and no 3D. No ruins, no fire, no gore, no skulls. All twelve houses must stay whole and recognizably paired with the original twelve. TRUE transparent background. No words or labels.
